sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Stainless Steel Swirl Texture Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a statement with these gold-toned stainless-steel hoops, featuring an eye-catching swirl texture. These fashionable earrings add a bold touch to your ensemble. To preserve their brilliant golden finish and intricate design, keep them away from moisture and perfumes, and store them safely in a dry place after use.
